name: Podkonické pleše Landing
notes:
Several possibilities of landing.
1) Next to the ranch (directly in the straight line from the take off) are several wide open spaces. Beware of sheep, cattle (shits produced from the as well) and  electric wiring
2) On the NE side of the village are fields suitable for landing - when there is no crop there.

notes: Below the hill there are many meadows where you can land safely.
